descriptions.text: Congratulations, Crawler! You've received a free fan booth at CrawlCon! With thousands of physical attendees and billions of virtual visitors, Dungeon Crawler World fans from all corners of the galaxy gather once every other season to geek out together over all things Crawl! With special guests, panels, vendors, cosplay, and so much more, CrawlCon is the event of the galaxy! Thanks to your fans, you've been added to the CrawlCon roster! You will attend three events! Your presence at the con will be virtual. Please see your outreach associate for details on your schedule.

recap.text: Carl opens a fan box with Katia watching and pulls out a postcard-sized badge on a red lanyard, its front showing a horned demon shooting fire. Zev has him put it around his neck and lose the bandana, and a CrawlCon schedule tab appears that Carl cannot open. In the green room, the badge lets him read the names floating over a two-headed ogre's heads: Dmitri and Maxim, the Popov brothers.

beats.headline: Fan box time
beats.text: Carl opens a fan box with Katia watching. A plastic rectangle pops out on a red lanyard printed Titan Entertainment in Syndicate standard. The badge is the size of a postcard. Its back scrolls with advertisements; its front shows a moving image of a horned demon shooting fire from its mouth, SPECIAL GUEST exploding along the edge, and a spinning logo reading Carl, Dungeon Crawler World: Earth. A timer appears at twenty-two hours. Carl reads the description: what the ever-loving fuck? Yeah, thanks, assholes, he tells the ceiling. Katia reads it and barks with laughter. He tells Zev to send Donut instead. It's in your best interests to be cooperative, Zev answers, just this once.
beats.gist: Carl opens a fan box and finds a CrawlCon badge naming him special guest, which Katia finds funny.

beats.headline: Around his neck
beats.text: Zev opens Carl's inventory for a moment: pull out the CrawlCon badge from the fan box and put it around your neck, take nothing else out, and lose the bandana. The red demon on the front roars silently, shooting fire, and the back scrolls an ad for a real estate venture on what looks like a swamp planet. A new tab appears in his interface, CrawlCon schedule, and he cannot open it. This vessel has its own containment zone, Zev explains, and his crawler wetware blocks him out.
beats.gist: Zev has Carl wear the CrawlCon badge, but its schedule tab stays locked.

beats.headline: Names without menus
beats.text: Zev makes Carl put the badge on again before he is transported down to the production facility for his next appearance. He lands hard in the green room in front of a two-headed ogre trying to play cards against itself. His menus are gone, but thanks to the badge he can still see the names floating over their heads: Dmitri on the right side, Maxim on the left, the Popov brothers, number five in the dungeon. They wear the badge too, around both their necks.
beats.gist: Carl, badge on again, lands in a green room and still reads the Popov brothers' names.
